vocabulary.example: His sudden departure from the company shocked everyone.

vocabulary.definition: a complete failure, especially in a ludicrous or humiliating way
vocabulary.example: The event turned out to be a fiasco due to poor planning.

vocabulary.definition: the action of working with someone to produce something
vocabulary.example: The two artists announced a collaboration on a new song.
